transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in today?

I came in because my talking gets all mixed up. I’ll try to explain something, like about the keys, and then I’m talking about jail, then a prayer rug, then chess pieces… and people tell me they can’t follow what I’m saying. I know it’s confusing, and I need help with that.
When your thoughts get mixed up like that, do you also feel like things around you are strange, unreal, or like they have a special meaning that others don’t understand?

Yeah… yes. I get that feeling. Like at work, even after my supervisor showed me the camera and there wasn’t anything there, I still felt sure the building people had marked me somehow. The hallway lights, and the little looks people gave each other… it felt like they were using those to warn each other about me.
Have you ever seen, heard, or felt things that others don’t, like voices commenting on your actions or seeing patterns that others can’t notice?

Yeah. Sometimes I hear a man’s voice, like it’s coming from the vents or from the mop closet. It’ll say my name, or say I ruined everything. And it sounds real… like somebody is standing right next to me saying it.
Have you ever had beliefs that others don’t share, like believing you have a special role, identity, or connection that most people wouldn’t understand?

Yes. When I get like that, I start believing I can fix the whole building myself, like I understand what’s wrong with everything better than anyone else. I’ll think I could show the bosses how it should be run… and maybe people all over town would know me for seeing things in a special way.
Do these experiences—like your thoughts getting mixed up, hearing voices, and feeling like things have a special meaning—happen all the time, or do they come and go in episodes?

They come and go, mostly. But it’s not only when I’m really up or really down. There have been calmer weeks where my mood wasn’t too high or too low, and I still heard that man’s voice in the vents. I still thought people in the building were signaling about me. That went on for more than a couple weeks at a time.
Have you had any ongoing signs of disturbance, like hearing voices or feeling like things have special meanings, for at least 6 months?

Yeah… it’s definitely been longer than 6 months. I’d say about 2 years and 5 months now, since after that brief detention over the misunderstanding at the building. It hasn’t really fully gone away since then.
Have you had ongoing experiences like hearing voices or feeling like things have special meanings, almost every day for at least 6 months without a break?
Yeah… the voices and that feeling like I’m being watched or marked, that’s been there almost every day. It’s been about a year and a half, I’d say, without much of a real break.
Have there been times when you felt down nearly every day or lost interest in things for more than just a couple of days, along with these other experiences like hearing voices or feeling watched?

Yeah. There are stretches where I feel down almost every day. On the bad days I’ll sit on the edge of the bed after morning prayer and just feel heavy and empty. Like there’s no point in even washing up or going outside.
Have you had any periods of at least six months where your symptoms, like hearing voices or feeling like things have special meanings, have been present without a significant break?
Yes. Like I said, the voices and the worries that I’m being watched or marked… they’ve been there for about a year and a half, pretty much without a real break.

During the time you’ve been experiencing these symptoms, has there been a continuous period of at least 6 months where the signs like hearing voices or feeling watched never really went away, even if they got a little better or worse at times?

Yes… that’s right. It’s been going on about a year and a half now. The voices and the feeling like I’m being watched or marked, they don’t really go away. Some days it’s a little less, some days worse, but it’s been there the whole time.

Has there been a time when you felt down nearly every day for at least two weeks, along with losing interest in things you used to enjoy, while also experiencing the voices or feelings of being watched?
Yes. On the bad days, after morning prayer, I’ll just sit on the edge of the bed feeling heavy and empty. I don’t feel like cleaning myself up or going outside. It feels like there’s no point.
